propositions: rebar comment <id> --body-file <path> stores the literal string '--body-file' as the comment body instead of rejecting the malformed invocation, exits 0, and silently discards the intended content
a positional-body argument beginning with '-' is silently accepted and stored as the body rather than rejected with a clear error message and usage hint
the args[:min_args] slice discards surplus positional arguments, compounding the silent loss when a flag-like token is stored as the body
all positional-body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) are vulnerable to the same footgun and need consistent guards
the '-- ' escape hatch must be documented and tested to allow legitimate bodies that begin with '-'
